items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Iona Roker. ... To my father, yeah. The first born.

ctx.x: You mentioned that your mother had been married before, and that she had had a daughter. What was her name -- your half sister -- what was her name?
Iona Roker. And that was in 1918 -- so were you the first born to your father?
